statement: The centre-free full extension of every cyclic order-four punctured-torus loop-outer action has exactly one Fhat2-conjugacy class of homomorphic order-four sections, preserving the generator label. The normalizer of a section B=<b> is C_F(b) times B, and H1(C_F(b),F2)=0. Conjugation by the order-four generator transposes two of the three section classes of its positive square and fixes the remaining class. Thus the full extension has two order-two subgroup conjugacy classes, and exactly one is contained in its unique order-four subgroup class.
depends_on: D46 actual order-four lift, three positive-involution section classes, localized evaluation algebra, and zero first mod-two fixed-group cohomology; D50 exact order-four two-adic matrix; full-profinite Brown restriction theorem; projectivity of closed subgroups of free profinite groups
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part D(b), full loop-outer finite actions in type (1,1)
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The three section points are supplied by the actual localized restriction algebra. The normalizer N=C semidirect C4 and quotient J=N/T=C semidirect C2 retain their specified embeddings and quotient labels. The inverse image of the quotient involution has order four because the kernel is precisely T=C2.
notes: The nonidentity affine linear part modulo two forces a transposition of the three distinguished section points. For the fixed square T, C=C_F(T) is projective, has cd2 at most one and H1(C,F2)=0. Thus the full quotient J=N_E(T)/T has the cohomology of C2. It has no C2 squared and has an open subgroup of finite two-cohomological dimension, so the inspected full Brown theorem applies; finite one-dimensional source cohomology makes its dense restriction embedding an isomorphism. The sum of 1 plus fixed-group H1 dimensions is one, giving a unique quotient involution class. Lifting its exact inverse image establishes the labelled C4 uniqueness. The finite certificate checks only the displayed affine and mod-four identities. Outer geometric conjugacy and the remaining mixed multipliers are not inferred.
